msg: warning: Variable k_crcs is a dead store!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 5275b1e49f6.c (BusyBox insmod). Dead store on 'k_crcs' at line 21 ('k_crcs = 0'), when def(CONFIG_FEATURE_INSMOD_VERSION_CHECKING). When VERSION_CHECKING=true, k_crcs is assigned 0 at line 21, but when r=1 this is overwritten at line 25 (k_crcs = someInt), and when r=0, k_crcs=0 is never read (goto out). The dead store is a simplification artifact — real BusyBox insmod code uses k_crcs extensively for CRC checking of kernel symbols. The known vbdb bug is the UndeclaredIdentifier on k_crcs at line 25 when VERSION_CHECKING=false (k_crcs is declared only inside #ifdef but referenced unconditionally).
